title: RunJobListQuery
description: run.job-list-query@1 (PLANNED; plan T14 R1): the query string of GET /api/v1/jobs on OpenVibe.Run (capability run.job.list) and of GET /api/v1/admin/jobs (run.job.admin, which alone may pass project_id). Without project_id it lists the caller's token project.

project_id.description: Admin only (run.job.admin): list this project's jobs; with run.job.list it is refused 403.

limit.description: Items per page, 1 to 200 (default 50). A query string carries it as a string, which must name the same range.
